description: Synthesize biomedical evidence across multiple studies, including randomized trials, observational cohorts, case reports, animal models, in vitro experiments, longitudinal studies, and meta-analyses. Use when comparing conflicting results, grading evidence strength, identifying replication, evaluating clinical relevance, and forming cautious conclusions from the totality of evidence.
